notes.title: Sassy Girl - Final
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282124/de5f4b590b8774267a5bf872dbfac4a38add99a9.jpg[/img]
I'm happy to have finished another game. It's not easy to work on these stories alone, with consistency and without ever losing passion. For this reason, I am satisfied with my work. Sassy Girl is an unusual story. I had a lot of fun playing with the controversial personalities of all the characters, and I’ll continue to do so in future projects.
Sassy reached 118,000 words, 4,100 images, 120 animations, and 390 choice menus. Initially, I didn't plan for it to be this long; I had forecasted 75,000 words and 2,500 images.
In this latest update, I also added eight new achievements. There are also 8 different endings, 3-4 main ones and the others small variations. 
The game will remain in early access for a few more weeks while I work on fixing any bugs that I hope will be reported to me.
I hope you enjoyed this adventure and that you will follow me in my future projects. Thank you to everyone who purchased this game and to those who will do so in the future. Thanks!
Alessio.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282124/e5d586e2b8b8f9af914ef352793d89e3a620f882.jpg[/img]

With this release we come to the final chapter of Sassy Girl.
MC, after going through some strange experiences and learning incredible truths, begins to doubt his sanity.
In this update you will meet again Carla the psychotherapist and the beautiful Dorothy.
Be careful with your choices, as they may lead you to an ending you do not want.

- 500 new images

- 20000 words 
- 20 animations
- 3 new achievements

notes.title: Sassy Girl 0.4.13
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce the arrival of a new update available immediately!
I hope you enjoy the update.
I look forward to your comments and suggestions!

In this update:
MC, Miriam, and Josephine find a new balance.
MC and Karen face a tough journey in the snow and get stuck in a mountain cabin. MC will have the opportunity to seduce Karen, but it won't be easy. Like all the girls of Sassy Girl, she's not playing with a full deck.
MC will meet Miriam at the pool and will be able to finally decide what kind of relationship to have with her.
MC will argue with Adele, but can reconcile by exploiting her bizarre sexual perversion.
Janine will return to visit MC bringing with her a complex truth. MC will be asked to make a very difficult decision.
MC will have to help Karen get revenge on the movie producer who blackmailed her years ago.
Miriam will lose control once again. Her schizophrenia will confuse MC, as during her delirium, stories will come out that conflict with the truth MC thinks he knows.

13 New scenes
20,000 words
700 images
20 animations
6500 lines of code
